extraction.Name: Richard D. Ellston
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded in the Todd County records by C. L. Dice on February 8, 1919 and in the Gregory county records it was recorded on March 25, 1919, but the information is not given as to who submitted the instrument for record.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to G. A. Roberts for $300.00; mortgaged May 8, 1920 for $12,000 including other land; conveyed on Oct. 2, 1922 to J. H. Ellston and Cornelius Ellston for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; a sheriff's sale on this land for the second [mortgage dated March 21, 1925]
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: A sheriff's sale on this land for the second [mortgage]
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 602113 issued September 28, 1917; receipt for patent signed by allottee November 8, 1918. Fee patent No. 653982 also referenced for this same land. Northeast quarter of section 11, township 95, range 71, and northeast quarter of section 1, township 35, range 27 conveyed by deed dated February 8, 1919; other land mortgaged March 31, 1919 for $300.00 signed by Richard Ellston to G. A. Roberts; mortgaged again May 8, 1920 for $12,000 including other land; conveyed Oct. 2, 1922 to J. H. Ellston and Cornelius Ellston; sheriff's sale deed dated March 21, 1925. Document dated 1929.
